kpis.citation: To help you model the back half of the year, we anticipate a sequential increase in adjusted operating income of $50 million-$100 million from Q3 to Q4, with timing of IKC being the biggest driver.

kpis.nom_source: OI for the quarter at the enterprise level was up
kpis.citation: OI for the quarter at the enterprise level was up about 5%.
It was roughly 10% for the quarter.
If you look at the average mix for the first half of the year, it's in the high tens and really tracking as we expected, in line with the $40 million headwind that we'd expect for the full year.

Hard to predict exactly how it's going to play out, but we would expect that number to sustain itself through some part of next year, and that's what leads to the $40 million impact and then the $70 million impact next year.

kpis.nom_source: less positivity than we were expecting
kpis.citation: In terms of the Fresenius closures, it's probably 5 basis points of less positivity than we were expecting on the year.
Capacity utilization is running in the high 50s now.

kpis.nom_fr: Taux d'utilisation des capacités pic pré-COVID
kpis.citation: If you went back pre-COVID, at its peak, it ran about 65%.

kpis.nom_fr: Tirage sur ligne de crédit renouvelable
kpis.citation: We had drawn down $65 million on our revolver.
This was purely about the 100 clinics they closed.
We are in a good spot year to date at $785 million.
